raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview
Follow-up of #57549

Enable EPLB for DeepSeek V4 and V4.1 DSpark drafts when their expert topology differs from the target model.
This PR covers DSpark’s draft model loader.
Related: [#59611](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/59611) fixes redundant expert loading in the target model. 


## Claims

- Register supported DSpark draft MoE models with the target’s EPLB state.
- Allow target and draft models to have different expert counts and topologies. Reduce load statistics per model when their physical expert counts differ, while retaining the combined reduction path when shapes match.
- Include redundant expert slots in the V4.1 DSpark fused-MoE weight mapping.

## Validation
- CPU-runnable pytest subset:.
- Add coverage for heterogeneous topology handling, EPLB registration, and DSpark redundant-slot mapping.

### GSM8K validation.

server:
```
vllm serve nvidia/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-NVFP4 \
  --port 8000 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --served-model-name nvidia/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-NVFP4 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 \
  --max-model-len 8192 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --enable-eplb \
  --eplb-config '{"num_redundant_experts":8,"step_interval":100,"log_balancedness":true}' \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":5}' \
```

client:
```
python \
  tests/evals/gsm8k/gsm8k_eval.py \
  --num-questions 1319 \
  --num-shots 5 \
  --max-tokens 256 \
  --host http://127.0.0.1 \
  --port 8000 \
  --temperature 0.0 \
  --seed 42 \
```

Result. Accuracy: 0.890


Logs:
```
(Worker_TP0_EP0 pid=2822063) INFO 10-14 18:33:21 [eplb_state.py:641] EPLB step: 79 for model nvidia/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-NVFP4 (draft): avg_tokens=4500.00, max_tokens=6896, balancedness=0.6526, steps until the next rearrangement: 21
(Worker_TP0_EP0 pid=2822063) INFO 10-14 18:33:21 [eplb_state.py:641] EPLB step: 79 for model nvidia/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-NVFP4: avg_tokens=238800.00, max_tokens=354552, balancedness=0.6735, steps until the next rearrangement: 21
```

Both models (target and draft) are involved in eplb rearrangement.


## Details

The target and DSpark draft can have different routed and physical expert counts. EPLB state now keeps topology-dependent counts per registered model and handles load-stat reductions when models have different physical expert dimensions.

DSpark’s custom weight loader is a separate call path from the target model’s `get_expert_mapping`. Since DSpark is now registered with EPLB, its redundant physical slots must also receive the replicated expert weights. #59611 addresses the target model’s mapping; end-to-end use with redundant experts requires that fix as well.


---

<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [ ] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [ ] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [ ] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [ ] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [ ] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

@@ -144,6 +144,22 @@ Enable EPLB with the `--enable-eplb` flag.
 
 When enabled, vLLM collects load statistics with every forward pass and periodically rebalances expert distribution.
 
+### Multimodel EPLB with speculative decoding
+
+When speculative decoding uses a draft model that implements `MixtureOfExperts`
+(for example Qwen3-Next MTP, EAGLE, or DeepSeek DSpark), vLLM registers the
+draft and target in the same `EplbState`. Each model keeps its own expert load
+windows, communicators, and rearrangement maps, but shares the same rearrangement
+step counter across EP ranks.
+
+Target and draft models may have different expert topologies. This is required
+for DeepSeek V4.1 DSpark, where draft layers use `dspark_n_routed_experts`
+while the target backbone uses the full routed-expert count. Each model is
+load-balanced independently.
+
+For every registered model, `(num_routed_experts + num_redundant_experts)` must
+be divisible by the EP world size.
+
 ### EPLB Parameters
 
 Configure EPLB with the `--eplb-config` argument, which accepts a JSON string. The available keys and their descriptions are:
